paraphrase: Whatever good and bad karma was accumulated in another birth, this śāstra makes manifest its ripening, as a lamp shows objects in the dark.

original.text: yad upacitam anyajanmani śubhāśubhaṃ tasya karmaṇaḥ paṅktim | vyañjayati śāstram etat tamasi dravyāṇi dīpa iva ||
